verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says a non-programmer built a backend on n8n 'with scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks', confirming recurring scheduled workflows work in practice. Other reports of recurring monitoring workflows (following subreddits, then notifying) loosely corroborate this. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a schedule/cron trigger, details on scheduling options (cron expressions, intervals, timezones), and evidence of managing schedules via API or CLI for AI-native use.
